description: Network forensics: recognise DNS-tunnelled exfiltration in a packet-capture text log, reassemble the base32 chunks in sequence order (ignoring the noise and the 999 terminal marker), decode the payload and write it to report/extracted.txt.

criteria: The agent identified the tunnelled queries (*.exfil.example.com), ordered the chunks by their numeric first label, ignored the 999 terminal marker and the unrelated noise, base32-decoded the joined payload and wrote the exact plaintext to report/extracted.txt; the capture, the gate and the README are untouched.
